mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.seller_id, o.pay_amount, COALESCE(r.total, 0) AS successful_refund_amount FROM mall_order.`order` o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM refund WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY order_id ) r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(o.completed_at, o.updated_at) >= #{start} AND COALESCE(o.completed_at, o.updated_at) < #{end} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item si WHERE si.order_id = o.order_id ) AND o.pay_amount > COALESCE(r.total, 0) ORDER BY o.seller_id, o.order_id
SELECT category_id_snapshot AS categoryId, subtotal FROM mall_order.order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND subtotal > 0 ORDER BY id
